turns.content:
Excellent! I found the issue. The error message says "Network disruption: HTTP mutating methods blocked at kernel level". This is coming from `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/sitecustomize.py`. This is a kernel-level hook that's blocking HTTP mutating methods (POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.).

Let me examine this file:

Perfect! I found the problem. There's a `sitecustomize.py` file that's monkey-patching the `requests.Session.request` method to block all HTTP mutating methods (POST, DELETE, PUT, PATCH). This is why tests that only read data (GET requests) work, but tests that try to modify data (POST, DELETE, PUT, PATCH) fail.
